payments_document_check.name: payments_document_check
payments_document_check.value: (order_id is not null and supplier_id is null and currency is null) or (order_id is null and supplier_id is not null and currency is not null and payee_role = 'supplier')

payments_void_check.name: payments_void_check
payments_void_check.value: (voided_at is null and voided_by is null and void_reason = '') or (voided_at is not null and btrim(void_reason) <> '')

payments_status_fields_check.name: payments_status_fields_check
payments_status_fields_check.value: (status = 'paid' and paid_on is not null and rate_inr > 0 and coalesce(mode, '') <> '') or (status = 'due' and due_date is not null)

clearings_charges_check.name: clearings_charges_check
clearings_charges_check.value: customs_duty_inr >= 0 and other_duties_inr >= 0 and agent_charges_inr >= 0 and port_charges_inr >= 0

clearings_cleared_check.name: clearings_cleared_check
clearings_cleared_check.value: status <> 'cleared' or (cleared_on is not null and duty_paid_on is not null)

transports_unloaded_check.name: transports_unloaded_check
transports_unloaded_check.value: status <> 'unloaded' or (unloaded_on is not null and bundles_received is not null)

supplier_advance_entries_shape_check.name: supplier_advance_entries_shape_check
supplier_advance_entries_shape_check.value:
(kind = 'receipt' and advance_id is null and reversal_of is null and order_id is null and po_number = '' and mode <> '' and payment_id is null)
        or (kind = 'allocation' and advance_id is not null and reversal_of is null and po_number <> '' and payment_id is null)
        or (kind = 'reversal' and advance_id is not null and reversal_of is not null and po_number <> '' and payment_id is null)
        or (kind = 'excess' and advance_id is null and reversal_of is null and po_number <> '')
        or (kind = 'excess_return' and advance_id is not null and reversal_of is null and po_number <> '' and payment_id is null)

supplier_ledger_entries_sign_check.name: supplier_ledger_entries_sign_check
supplier_ledger_entries_sign_check.value:
(entry_type = 'payment' and amount > 0) or (entry_type = 'payment_void' and amount < 0)
        or (entry_type = 'order_debit' and amount <= 0) or (entry_type = 'order_cancel' and amount >= 0)
        or (entry_type in ('order_adjustment', 'adjustment') and amount <> 0)

supplier_ledger_entries_shape_check.name: supplier_ledger_entries_shape_check
supplier_ledger_entries_shape_check.value:
(entry_type = 'payment' and num_nonnulls(payment_id, advance_entry_id) = 1 and order_id is null and reverses_id is null)
        or (entry_type = 'payment_void' and num_nonnulls(payment_id, advance_entry_id) = 1 and order_id is null and reverses_id is not null)
        or (entry_type in ('order_debit', 'order_adjustment', 'order_cancel') and payment_id is null and advance_entry_id is null and reverses_id is null and po_number <> '')
        or (entry_type = 'adjustment' and payment_id is null and advance_entry_id is null and order_id is null and reverses_id is null
            and origin = 'app' and btrim(notes) <> '' and exchange_rate is not null and created_by is not null
            and balance_before is not null and balance_after = balance_before + amount)

supplier_ledger_entries_balances_check.name: supplier_ledger_entries_balances_check
supplier_ledger_entries_balances_check.value: (entry_type = 'adjustment') = (balance_before is not null and balance_after is not null)

supplier_ledger_entries_rate_check.name: supplier_ledger_entries_rate_check
supplier_ledger_entries_rate_check.value: exchange_rate is null or (exchange_rate > 0 and (currency <> 'INR' or exchange_rate = 1))
